answer: A mechanism that actually bites: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because zephyr only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, basalt is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any ridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
